Xi noted that people's health is a key {{5}} of a {{6}} nation and a strong country. Since the 18th National Congress of the CPC in 2012, the CPC Central Committee has made {{8}} people's health a {{7}} priority in the country's development. paragraphs.cn: 这些努力推动了世界上规模最大的医疗服务体系、传统医药体系、疾病预防控制体系和医疗保障体系的发展，标志着卫生领域取得了历史性成就和全面进步。习近平表示，我们的目标是建设一个均衡、包容、高质量、高效率的健康中国，国家应在健康管理、疾病预防控制、医疗服务、医保支撑、药品创新和人才培养等方面具备强大能力，以有效满足人民日益增长的健康需求，确保主要健康指标持续稳步提升。习近平指出，卫生领域具有全局性和基础性作用，必须坚定不移实施健康优先发展战略。保障人民健康必须融入所有政策，体现在工作的方方面面。习近平表示，在制定规划、设计政策、评估项目、开展建设时，必须始终把对人民健康的影响放在首位。

He said it is {{16}} to guide the public in developing a correct understanding of health and engaging in effective self-care and health management. Young people should be encouraged to develop good study and lifestyle habits and achieve well-rounded development in terms of moral grounding, intellectual capability, physical vigor, aesthetic sensibility and work skills. Efforts should be made to create a favorable ecological, working and living environment, encourage and support fitness for all and healthy leisure activities, and strengthen food safety {{17}} to ensure that every bite of food is safe. paragraphs.cn: 习近平强调预防是最经济最有效的健康策略，要求细致做好公共卫生和医疗健康基础性工作，从源头上解决健康问题，为全体人民健康奠定坚实基础。他表示，必须引导公众树立正确的健康观念，进行有效的自我保健和健康管理。应鼓励年轻人养成良好的学习和生活习惯，在道德、智力、体质、审美和劳动技能方面实现全面发展。应努力创造良好的生态、工作和生活环境，鼓励和支持全民健身和健康休闲活动，加强食品安全监管，确保每一口食物都安全。习近平还表示，必须完善疾病预防控制体系，确保不发生大规模流行病。

paragraphs.en: Xi noted that comprehensively improving medical services is a key task in building a Healthy China. It is essential to advance a program aimed at enhancing primary-level healthcare, {{19}} the functions and structural layout of healthcare institutions, and promote tiered diagnosis and treatment, so that people can readily access quality medical care close to home. It is necessary to strengthen comprehensive prevention and control of chronic diseases, and improve whole-chain services covering prevention, treatment, {{20}} and management. Mechanisms for the {{21}}, innovation, and development of traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) should be improved to enhance integrated development of TCM and Western medicine. Xi called for efforts to strengthen basic research and original innovation in the health sector, facilitate the {{22}} of scientific and technological achievements into practical applications, and expand and strengthen the health industry.
paragraphs.cn: 习近平指出，全面提高医疗服务质量是建设健康中国的关键任务。必须推进基层医疗健康能力提升工程，优化医疗机构职能和结构布局，促进分级诊疗，使人民能够就近获得优质医疗服务。有必要加强慢性病综合防控，完善涵盖预防、治疗、康复和管理的全链条服务。应完善中医药传承创新发展的机制，促进中西医结合发展。习近平呼吁加强卫生领域基础研究和原始创新，促进科技成果转化应用，做大做强健康产业。

paragraphs.en: He also said it is necessary to enhance the patient experience, and continuously improve public access to and {{23}} with healthcare services. Xi stressed that reform is a strong driving force for the development of the health sector, and that the {{24}} development and regulation of medical services, medical insurance and pharmaceuticals should be the primary focus of reforming the health system. Efforts must be made to fully implement the reform plan for public health and medical institutions, deepen public hospital reform with a commitment to their public-welfare nature, and provide greater support for the running of community-level healthcare facilities in counties and districts. Measures should be taken to establish a multi-tiered healthcare security system, with optimized policies on centralized procurement of drugs and consumables, medical insurance payments and fund utilization, so as to ensure the safe operation of insurance funds and the sound operation of hospitals, and keep healthcare expenses within an affordable range for the public. Efforts must be made to improve mechanisms for ensuring the supply and management of medicines, refine the national system of essential medicines, and strengthen oversight of pharmaceutical quality and safety.
paragraphs.cn: 他还表示，有必要提升患者体验，不断提高公众对医疗服务的可及性和满意度。习近平强调，改革是卫生领域发展的强大动力，医疗服务、医疗保险和医药的协同发展与调控应成为卫生体制改革的主要着力点。必须全面实施公共卫生和医疗机构改革方案，深化公立医院改革，坚持其公益性质，加大对县区基层医疗机构运行的支持力度。应采取措施建立多层次医疗保障体系，优化药品和耗材集中采购、医保支付和基金使用政策，确保医保基金安全运行和医院良性运转，使医疗费用保持在公众可承受范围内。必须完善药品供应和管理机制，完善国家基本药物制度，加强药品质量安全监管。

He also stressed enhancing work ethics and conduct, fostering a sound professional ethos, and promoting a social atmosphere of respect for medical professionals and high regard for the health profession. Xi stressed that health for all is a shared aspiration of humanity. It is necessary to actively advance the building of a global community of health for all, join hands to address major challenges in the health sector, and continuously improve the health and well-being of people in all countries.

With great ideological, strategic, and guiding significance, the speech charts the course and provides essential guidelines for advancing China's health sector in the new era and on the new journey. Li called for actions to earnestly study and deeply understand the speech, implement it fully and without compromise, enhance consciousness in both thought and action, and unswervingly follow the path of health development with Chinese characteristics. paragraphs.en: We must focus on the pain points and bottlenecks in the health sector, and give priority to addressing the pressing difficulties and problems that concern the people most, Li said. Vigorous efforts should be made to prevent and control major diseases, advance the development of the tiered diagnosis and treatment system, improve people's experience of seeking and receiving medical services, build a multi-tiered healthcare security system, leverage the unique strengths of traditional Chinese medicine, improve health services for the elderly and children, and promote the empowerment of the medical and health sector by science and technology, so as to lay a solid foundation for building a Healthy China. Members of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and members of the Secretariat of the CPC Central Committee, vice chairperson of the CMC, leading officials of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress, state councilors, the procurator-general of the Supreme People's Procuratorate, and leading officials of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference attended the meeting. Also present at the meeting were leading officials of provinces, autonomous regions, municipalities directly under the central government, cities specifically designated in the state plan, and the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps, leading officials from relevant central Party and government departments, people's organizations, some state-owned enterprises directly administered by the central government, and relevant departments of the CMC, as well as representatives of experts and scholars.
paragraphs.cn: 李强表示，我们必须聚焦卫生领域的痛点和瓶颈，优先解决人民群众最关心最直接最现实的困难问题。要大力加强重大疾病防控，推进分级诊疗制度建设，改善群众看病就医体验，构建多层次医疗保障体系，发挥中医药独特优势，提升老年人和儿童健康服务，推动科学技术对医疗卫生事业的赋能，为建成健康中国奠定坚实基础。出席会议的还有中共中央政治局委员、中央书记处书记，中央军委副主席，全国人大常委会有关领导同志，国务委员，最高人民法院院长，最高人民检察院检察长，全国政协有关领导同志。参加会议的还有各省、自治区、直辖市和计划单列市、新疆生产建设兵团负责同志，中央和国家机关有关部门、有关人民团体、中央管理的部分国有企业、中央军委机关有关部门负责同志，以及专家学者代表。

The 140th China Import and Export Fair, also known as the Canton Fair, runs in three phases from October 15 to November 4, Guangzhou, south China's Guangdong Province. 
The 140th China Import and Export Fair (Canton Fair) opened in Guangzhou on Thursday, as President Xi Jinping called for deeper international economic cooperation and the safeguarding of global supply chains, highlighting China's commitment to opening up.
In a congratulatory letter marking the fair's 70th anniversary, Xi said over the past 70 years since its establishment, the Canton Fair has played a significant role in promoting trade exchanges between China and other countries, serving as an effective platform for China to expand high-level opening up and promote the building of an open world economy.
The message comes as China's foreign trade continues to expand. According to data released by the General Administration of Customs on Wednesday, China's total imports and exports of goods rose 18.8% year on year to 39.94 trillion yuan ($5.97 trillion) in the first nine months of 2026, the fastest growth for the same period in five years. Exports increased 16.4% to 23.2 trillion yuan, while imports grew faster, rising 22.3% to 16.74 trillion yuan.
Lyu Yue, vice dean of the School of International Trade and Economics at the University of International Business and Economics, told China Media Group (CMG) that China's trade resilience reflects strength on both the supply and demand sides.
"Chinese industries are turning technological advances into high-quality products that meet global demand, while the country's vast market creates opportunities for foreign businesses," Lyu said.
This demand-side strength is also reflected in China's role as a major importer. The country has been the world's second-largest import market for 17 consecutive years, and its 15th Five-Year Plan (2026-2030) calls for more balanced import and export growth.
Trade growth has also extended across major partners. China's trade with ASEAN reached 6.84 trillion yuan, up 22.7%, while trade with the European Union rose 8.4% to 4.78 trillion yuan. Trade with other APEC economies increased 23.9% to 24.07 trillion yuan.
Intermediate goods accounted for more than half of China's exports in the first three quarters, while equipment manufacturing contributed nearly 90% of export growth, customs data showed. These goods supply components and equipment to businesses across international production networks.
The high share of intermediate goods reflects the breadth of China's industrial base, said Zhou Mi, a senior research fellow at the Institute of American and Oceania Studies of the Chinese Academy of International Trade and Economic Cooperation under the Ministry of Commerce.
The fair comes amid scrutiny from some Western economies over China's manufacturing capacity and trade imbalances, with concerns that Chinese exports are intensifying competitive pressure on overseas producers.
"Chinese companies have developed economies of scale and industrial clusters across a wide range of sectors, supplying intermediate goods that help other countries develop their industries and advance industrialization," Zhou told CMG. The country also imports large volumes of intermediate goods from abroad, with such trade reflecting the close integration of economies and creating opportunities to share the benefits of development, he added.
Foreign-invested companies in China are also benefiting from the country's growth. Their imports and exports rose 19% year on year in the first three quarters, reaching a record high for the period. A September report by the American Chamber of Commerce in Shanghai found that more member companies viewed China as a global base for innovation, production and sourcing, with "in China, for the world" emerging as a preferred business strategy.
"China's expanding domestic market and efforts to facilitate trade are creating more opportunities for foreign businesses," Zhou said. At a time when global trade faces challenges from protectionism and unilateralism, China's open market offers greater stability and confidence, helping encourage further cooperation, he added.
The Canton Fair offers a window into China's international commerce connections. Running from October 15 to November 4, the event spans 1.55 million square meters and features more than 30,000 exhibitors and 340,000 overseas buyers. New and green products account for record shares of 23.2% and 26% of exhibits, respectively.
Rather than treating trade as a zero-sum contest, Xi's letter places the emphasis on maintaining an open trading system and expanding mutually beneficial cooperation.
"China is willing to join hands with countries around the world to safeguard the multilateral trading system, ensure the stability and smooth operation of global industrial and supply chains, expand the space for mutually beneficial international economic and trade cooperation, and promote a universally beneficial and inclusive economic globalization, to inject new momentum into global development and prosperity," Xi wrote.

articles.fullText:
Japan is home to tens of thousands of shrines of all sizes, and Yasukuni Shrine in central Tokyo is one of the most controversial.
Honoring 14 convicted Class-A criminals from World War II, the notorious shrine has long been a source of diplomatic friction between Japan and its neighbors, including China and South Korea.
Yet Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi on Saturday sent a ritual offering – a potted plant under her title as prime minister – to the war-linked shrine as its three-day autumn festival began.
Takaichi, seen by some as a strongly right-wing advocate of military expansion among Japan's postwar prime ministers, had visited the shrine during its spring and autumn festivals and on August 15, the anniversary of Japan's unconditional surrender in World War II.
In recent years, visits to Yasukuni Shrine by Japanese leaders and senior cabinet officials have only ended up straining Tokyo's relations with its Asian neighbors.
On August 15, 2026, the Chinese Foreign Ministry officially lodged serious protests after Takaichi made a monetary offering and some of her cabinet members visited the shrine on the 81st anniversary of Japan's WWII surrender.
"This is an affront to historical justice, a challenge to the foundational norms of civilization, and a provocation against the postwar international order," the ministry said back then.
In its aftermath, South Korea's Foreign Ministry also issued a statement, stressing that Seoul cannot but deplore the fact that responsible leaders of Japan once again forgot history and repeated anachronistic acts by sending offerings to or paying tributes at the shrine.
A distorted version of history
Facing outrage from the victims of Japan's wartime aggression, Japanese politicians often seek to downplay the controversy, claiming, "Yasukuni Shrine is merely a Shinto site for honoring and consoling the spirits of the dead."
Yet the site is filled with symbols closely tied to Japanese militarism and war.
The bases of two large stone lanterns at the shrine feature bas-reliefs depicting Japan's wars, including the First Sino-Japanese War of 1894-1895 (also known as the Jiawu War) and the suppression of indigenous uprisings in China's Taiwan region under Japanese colonial rule, deliberately highlighting them as Japanese military "feats." Some of these images were even printed on postcards.
But where, then, is the mourning for the blood and tears of the countless Asian civilians who suffered in these so-called feats of the Japanese army? In China alone, 14-year war against Japanese aggression resulted in over 35 million Chinese military and civilian casualties, data shows.
Another striking irony is that Hideki Tojo, the most atrocious war criminal who served as Japanese prime minister between 1941 and 1944 during Japan's aggression in Asia, is enshrined as a "Showa Martyr."
It was under Tojo's leadership that Japan launched its aggression, where millions across the Asia were brutally killed. Warfare soon engulfed much of East and Southeast Asia, pushing as far as British-controlled India. Across these occupied territories, Japanese militarists launched large-scale massacres, enforced forced labor and wrought widespread devastation.
Tojo was sentenced to death for war crimes by the International Military Tribunal for the Far East and executed by hanging in 1948.
Of the 14 Class-A war criminals enshrined at the shrine, 13 were directly involved in Japan's war of aggression against China or bore major responsibility for shaping and implementing its invasion policies.
Inside its Yushukan museum, Japan's wartime past is unabashedly sanitized: Imperial conquest is framed as Asian liberation, and atrocities are systematically brushed aside. The Nanjing Massacre, where some 300,000 Chinese people were killed, is reduced to a brief line of prosecuting "Chinese soldiers disguised in civilian clothes." The death-ridden Thai-Burma Railway is celebrated merely for its engineering utility.
Unlike other historical sites in Japan, there are no Chinese or Korean guides or explanations at Yasukuni Shrine. Some right-wing Japanese forums have even called for Chinese and Korean-language materials to be produced for Yushukan, in an attempt to persuade visitors from the two countries to accept its specific framing of the war's so-called "correct history."
Yet among the visitors, there are those who recognize the undeniable truth.
In the Yushukan guestbook, an English message signed J.D. reads: "I feel very sad and concerned about Japan and the Japanese perception of history."

articles.title: Jane Eyre finds herself on the Chinese musical stage
articles.titleCn: 简·爱登上中国音乐剧舞台
articles.summary: How can a 19th-century classic speak to audiences in 2026? CGTN goes behind the scenes of the original Chinese musical Jane Eyre to discover how Charlotte Brontë's timeless masterpiece is being reimagined for the contemporary stage.
articles.summaryCn: 中国原创音乐剧《简·爱》通过“内心法庭”等创新手法，将维多利亚时代经典本土化、现代化，让当代观众共鸣于简·爱对自我决定的不懈追求。

paragraphs.en:
In Charlotte Brontë's 19th-century masterpiece Jane Eyre, the simple yet powerful declaration "I will be myself" defined a woman's {{0}} battle for {{1}}. Today, nearly two centuries later, those same words ring out with new energy – this time set to music on the Chinese stage. Following its premiere in Shanghai this August, an original Chinese musical adaptation of Jane Eyre is offering contemporary audiences an {{2}} of the timeless classic, {{3}} Victorian literature with 21st-century theatrical storytelling. The production introduces a {{4}} device – an inner courtroom – to {{5}} Jane Eyre's inner world. /Original Chinese Musical Jane Eyre
Adapting a novel for a {{6}} theatrical production presents a unique challenge.
paragraphs.cn:
在夏洛蒂·勃朗特19世纪的杰作《简·爱》中，那句简单而有力的宣言“我要做我自己”定义了一个女人对自我决定的不懈斗争。近两个世纪后的今天，同样的话语带着新的能量回响——这一次是在中国舞台上以音乐剧的形式呈现。继今年8月在上海首演后，一部原创中文音乐剧《简·爱》为当代观众提供了对这部永恒经典的全新诠释，将维多利亚时代的文学与21世纪的戏剧叙事连接起来。该剧引入了一个反复出现的装置——一个“内心法庭”——来将简·爱的内心世界外化。/原创中文音乐剧《简·爱》
将小说改编为充满活力的戏剧作品是一项独特的挑战。

paragraphs.en:
For director Jin Shengquan, the key lay in capturing Jane's rich inner life and translating her {{7}} journey into {{8}} visual and musical language. "When reading the novel, what stands out most is Jane's attitude toward the world. She is a woman with a rich, full inner life," Jin, who also plays Edward Rochester, told CGTN. "The biggest challenge for the stage was finding a way to {{9}} those internal thoughts and emotions. That led us to put Jane’s personal growth at the absolute center of our adaptation."
To bring her internal {{10}} into sharp relief, the production introduces a creative recurring device: an "inner courtroom." In these {{11}} sequences, Jane faces trial under the {{12}} charge of "seeking affection" or "falling in love." In Charlotte Brontë's 19th-century masterpiece Jane Eyre, the simple yet powerful declaration "I will be myself" defined a woman's unwavering battle for self-determination. Today, nearly two centuries later, those same words ring out with new energy – this time set to music on the Chinese stage.

"The biggest challenge for the stage was finding a way to externalize those internal thoughts and emotions. That led us to put Jane’s personal growth at the absolute center of our adaptation."
To bring her internal conflict into sharp relief, the production introduces a creative recurring device: an "inner courtroom." In these stylized sequences, Jane faces trial under the absurd charge of "seeking affection" or "falling in love." Through resisting these voices of judgment – both external social expectations and her own internal self-doubt – Jane gradually breaks free, realizing her independence.
A modern, localized spin
Rather than producing a faithful Victorian period piece, the creative team deliberately localized and modernized the narrative to resonate deeply with today's Chinese audience.
"When interpreting a classic work like this, we must bring our own perspective," Jin explained. "We didn't want audiences to feel a sense of distance – whether from a Western literary classic or a Victorian setting."
This contemporary lens dynamically reshapes the story's classic archetypes. The religious austerity of St. John is softened to reveal his human vulnerability and suppressed personal desires.

'I will be myself'
For lead actress Guo Yaorong, who first read Jane Eyre under her blanket as a middle school student, stepping into Jane's shoes revealed deeper layers to the iconic character.
"Through portraying her inner world on stage, I discovered a side of her that is sensitive, fearful, and at times unsure of how to face the world," Guo said. "Jane Eyre is a story people can truly relate to. Whatever you go through, you need to hold on to your principles, make your own choices, and set your own goals."
Asked what Jane Eyre would be like if she lived in 2026, Guo believes she wouldn't necessarily be a celebrated figure. "She might just be an ordinary young woman – stubborn, staying true to her heart, particularly in her career, and living an ordinary life like anyone else."
Beyond borders
The enduring relevance of Jane Eyre in modern China – where it remains on the Ministry of Education's required reading list for students – underscores the universal power of world literature.
"A literary classic is a classic because it transcends national borders, languages, and generations," Jin noted. "In the global landscape of culture, we should embrace greater integration and mutual appreciation."
At its core, this Chinese adaptation strip away historical distance to honor the timeless quest for self-actualization. As the musical's central anthem boldly proclaims: "I don't need to be defined. I will be myself."

2026年10月11日，也门亚丁，车辆驶过一个环岛，环岛上设有宣传亚丁市的标志牌。也门政府周四表示，胡塞武装对也门南部港口城市亚丁的总统府大院发动袭击，造成5人死亡、16人受伤。胡塞武装声称有沙特军官在袭击中死伤。公共卫生与人口部长卡西姆·布海贝在声明中说，死伤者包括在阿尔马希克总统府大院工作的保安和文职雇员，该大院是国际公认的也门政府的临时所在地。周四早些时候，一名当地安全官员说，五枚导弹击中了总统府大院，另一次袭击针对的是亚丁阿尔布赖卡区的沙特领导的联军总部。

据现场记者报道，袭击期间亚丁发生剧烈爆炸，总统府附近升起浓烟。当地消息人士告诉新华社，该大院最近举行了“高层会议”，为沙特支持的政府军打击胡塞武装做准备。胡塞武装军事发言人叶海亚·萨里阿说，该组织袭击了亚丁的“沙特军事行动总部”，但没有说明具体位置。胡塞武装运营的马西拉电视台后来援引一名胡塞军事领导人的话说，沙特军官在针对亚丁总统府大院内“沙特军官管理的军事行动总部”的袭击中死伤。沙特阿拉伯或沙特领导的联军尚未对该说法立即发表评论。

此次袭击标志着胡塞武装与沙特阿拉伯之间的对抗进一步升级，双方近日来加强了相互打击。沙特领导的联军周四表示，自10月1日以来，胡塞武装对沙特首都利雅得哈立德国王国际机场的袭击已造成17人死亡、330多人受伤，该机场在两周内遭到20次袭击。与此同时，胡塞武装说，沙特战机在过去24小时内对也门胡塞武装控制区进行了65次空袭和导弹袭击。联合国安理会周四强烈谴责胡塞武装对沙特阿拉伯不断升级的袭击，包括影响民用航空和能源基础设施的袭击。安理会成员要求胡塞武装立即停止在也门的军事升级，并重申支持政治解决。

据媒体报道，沙特公共外交副大臣拉耶德·克里姆利周四告诉记者，在7月此次升级开始时，胡塞武装拒绝了利雅得关于在阿曼举行会议“解决悬而未决的分歧”的呼吁。自2014年底胡塞武装夺取首都萨那和也门北部大部分地区、迫使政府迁出首都以来，也门一直深陷冲突之中。
